activity_summary: You wrote the call down as it happened. The paper was received. Nothing more was said, and you did not ask. The proverb was not copied out and not sent to a printer. The chair is mended, and Master Kemp is not to sit on it.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Wrote the note and left both the proverb and the chair where the morning had put them.

entities.name: the paper left at the lodge
entities.context: Mentioned in Nothing more was asked

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: Nothing more. I did not ask.
